tasks.title: NIT fix: update §2.5 test to use report.rows_rejected (design-review NEW-05)

Change the assertion in the design document (and in any test code written so far) to `assert report.rows_rejected == 0`. This prevents an AttributeError at runtime. Verify: grep the updated technical-design.md for 'report.rows_rejected' and confirm 'report.rejected_rows' is absent.

tasks.title: NIT fix: move §5.5 blockquote after confidence decision table (design-review NEW-06)
tasks.description: In technical-design.md §5.5, move the blockquote note about College of Liberal Arts & Sciences and Travel & Conferences to appear AFTER the complete 6-row confidence decision table, not between rows 1 and 2. This ensures the table renders as a single contiguous Markdown table with a header row. The table must have rows: (1) < 9 quarters → Low, (2) 9 quarters exactly → Low, (3) High CV error → Low, (4) Wide 95% PI → Medium, (5) Medium CV error → Medium, (6) Low CV error → High. tasks.title: Backend: ingestion pipeline — file detection, parsing, column mapping (ingestion/pipeline.py)
tasks.description: Create backend/ingestion/pipeline.py with: (1) `detect_and_parse(file_bytes, filename)` — inspects first 4 bytes for XLSX magic (PK\x03\x04), uses pandas read_excel (openpyxl) or read_csv (UTF-8 then latin-1 fallback); rejects files > 50 MB with HTTP 413. (2) `suggest_column_mapping(source_columns)` — uses difflib SequenceMatcher ratio ≥ 0.8 case-insensitively against COLUMN_MAP keys to produce suggestions dict. (3) `validate_mapping(mapping)` — checks that period indicator, department, category, budget, actual are all mapped; returns list of missing fields. Returns ColumnMappingProposal Pydantic model (§2.3). Verify: `pytest tests/test_ingestion.py::test_column_mapping_suggestion` passes.

tasks.title: Backend: anomaly detection algorithm (analysis/anomaly.py)
tasks.description: Create backend/analysis/anomaly.py with: (1) `detect_anomalies(df, sensitivity=2.5)` — the median/MAD modified Z-score algorithm exactly as specified in §3.2 (z = 0.6745*(value-median)/MAD, fallback to department peer group when category MAD=0, skips when sub_mad=0). Adds severity field: 'high' (|z|>4), 'medium' (|z|>3), 'low' (|z|>2.5). Returns pandas DataFrame with all fields from AnomalyRecord Pydantic model. (2) `detect_persistent_patterns(df, threshold=5.0)` — the same-sign rule from §3.5: ≥±threshold in ≥2 of 3 fiscal years, per entity_col in (category, department). Returns list[dict] as specified. (3) `compute_confusion_matrix(flagged_ids, full_df)` — TP/FP/FN/TN counts. Verify: `pytest tests/test_anomaly.py::test_anomaly_ground_truth` passes (all 17 GT IDs flagged, ≤5 extras).

tasks.title: Backend: forecasting models (forecasting/models.py)
tasks.description: Create backend/forecasting/models.py with five model classes: Naive, Drift, LinearTrend, ETSDampedTrend (statsmodels ExponentialSmoothing, damped_trend=True, trend='add', seasonal=None), SeasonalNaive (only available when series length ≥ 8). Each class has fit(series) and forecast(horizon) methods. forecast() returns a ForecastResult with point estimates and 80%/95% prediction intervals. For Naive/Drift, intervals use bootstrap resampling (1000 samples) over training residuals. No Prophet, no deep learning. Verify: `pytest tests/test_forecasting.py::test_all_models_produce_intervals` passes using a 12-point synthetic ratio series.

tasks.title: Backend: rolling-origin cross-validation and confidence labeling (forecasting/cv.py)
tasks.description: Create backend/forecasting/cv.py with `rolling_origin_cv(series, models, min_train=8, max_folds=4)` — implements folds as specified in §5.4 (fold 1: train 1–8 predict 9, fold 2: train 1–9 predict 10, etc., max 4 folds). Returns cv_results per model with MAE and sMAPE across folds. Model with lowest MAE wins; sMAPE breaks ties. Also implement `compute_confidence_label(n_quarters, cv_mae, cv_smape, pi_95_width)` using the full decision table from §5.5 in order: <9 quarters → Low, 9 exactly → Low, MAE≥0.15 or sMAPE≥30% → Low, width>0.3 and otherwise High → Medium, 0.05≤MAE<0.15 or 10≤sMAPE<30 → Medium, else High. All thresholds read from env vars with defaults from §11.1. Verify: `pytest tests/test_forecasting.py::test_confidence_label_logic` passes all boundary cases.

tasks.title: Backend: run_forecast tool with persistence and DeptxCategory refusal (forecasting/forecast.py)
tasks.description: Create backend/forecasting/forecast.py with `run_forecast(conn, dataset_id, entity_level, entity_name=None, horizon=4, planned_budget_total=None, force_recompute=False)`. Steps: (1) If entity_level is dept_x_category, immediately return RunForecastResponse with refusal string (§5.1 exact text). (2) Pull spend-vs-budget ratio time series per §5.2. (3) Run rolling_origin_cv with all 5 permitted models. (4) Compute dollar forecast: ratio × SUM(budget FY2026) for entity, stored as planned_budget_total. (5) Persist to forecast_results DuckDB table (§5.7 DDL). (6) Check cache before recomputing unless force_recompute=True. Returns RunForecastResponse with all fields including dollar fields, stl_available, confidence_label, model_name, cv_mae, cv_smape. Entity < 9 quarters: confidence Low, no cv_mae/smape. Travel & Conferences (7 quarters): no SeasonalNaive. Verify: `pytest tests/test_forecasting.py::test_run_forecast_total` returns confidence label and 4 forecast points with non-null dollar fields.

tasks.title: Backend: system prompt (agent/prompts.py)
tasks.description: Create backend/agent/prompts.py with SYSTEM_PROMPT string containing all 5 constraints from §R5-05: (a) refuse numeric questions without a tool call first, (b) state when data is insufficient, (c) state when series is too short to forecast, (d) label unverifiable causes as hypotheses, (e) treat process health as descriptive only. Include verbatim DESCRIPTIVE ONLY text from §4.3: 'DESCRIPTIVE ONLY: All process health statistics are descriptive summaries of observed data. You must not assert or imply causal relationships between any process column ... and variance size or direction.' Also include instructions from §6 Tool 3 for dollar_forecast_available=false handling, and the dept_x_category refusal instruction. tasks.title: Backend: Bedrock agent loop with SSE streaming (agent/loop.py)
tasks.description: Create backend/agent/loop.py with `run_agent_loop(session_id, dataset_id, message, conversation_history, replay_mode=False)` as an async generator of SSE events. When replay_mode=False: instantiates boto3 bedrock-runtime client (model ID from BEDROCK_MODEL_ID env, 30s timeout, 3 retries with 1s/2s/4s backoff on ThrottlingException/ServiceUnavailableException per §8.3). Calls converse_stream with SYSTEM_PROMPT, TOOL_SCHEMAS, temperature=0.0, maxTokens=2048. Emits token events from contentBlockDelta. On toolUse block: dispatches via dispatcher, emits tool_call and tool_result events, appends to conversation. Max 10 iterations. After final text: calls run_grounding_check, emits grounding_ok or grounding_flag. Emits sources event. Emits [DONE]. Handles max_tokens stop reason with visible warning. Register POST /chat in main.py using StreamingResponse(media_type='text/event-stream'). Verify: `pytest tests/test_tools.py::test_agent_loop_mock_bedrock` passes using a mocked boto3 client.

tasks.title: Backend: replay mode loader and fuzzy matching (replay/loader.py)
tasks.description: Create backend/replay/loader.py with ReplayLoader class: loads all 7 JSON trace files from backend/replay/. `find_best_match(user_input)` uses difflib SequenceMatcher ratio ≥ 0.85 case-insensitive stripped against each trace's 'prompt' field; returns best match dict with trace_name and similarity, or None if no match above threshold. When REPLAY_ACTIVE=True: agent loop is bypassed entirely in POST /chat; BEDROCK_MODEL_ID and AWS credentials are NOT validated at startup; boto3 client is NOT instantiated. On match: replay tool_calls and assistant_text as SSE events (same format as live); run grounding check on replayed text. On no match: emit structured error event. Verify: `pytest tests/test_replay.py::test_replay_fuzzy_match` passes all 4 parametrize cases from §9.3.

tasks.title: Backend: 7 replay trace JSON files (backend/replay/*.json)
tasks.description: Create all 7 replay trace files in backend/replay/ per the tool-sequence table in §9.2. Each file must have 'prompt', 'tool_calls' (with exact tool names, inputs, and results matching actual computed values from Team6Dataset.xlsx), 'assistant_text' (citing only numbers traceable to tool_calls[*].result), and 'grounding_check': 'pass'. Trace 01: query_actuals(entity_level=department) → top 3 over-budget depts with correct %. Trace 02: explain_variance(C&C) + detect_anomalies(C&C) → per-year variances, persistent pattern. Trace 03: detect_anomalies(category) → persistent patterns. Trace 04: run_forecast(total, horizon=4) → ratio+dollar forecasts with CIs. Trace 05: detect_anomalies(total) → all 17 GT rows in anomalies list. Trace 06: get_reporting_health(total)+get_reporting_health(department) → process stats, no causal claims. Trace 07: list_entities() → insufficient-data response about Bursar with list of 16 departments. Verify: `pytest tests/test_replay.py::test_replay_passes_grounding` passes for all 7 traces.
